boards.title: Your First Weekend at The University of the South, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-key, under-21-safe sequence for getting oriented to campus, its shared spaces, and the Domain during a first weekend.

cards.title: Start with a chapel walk-through
cards.subtitle: Central campus · arrival-day landmark
cards.notes: Step inside during an open worship time, or walk the exterior first; check the chapel’s current schedule before planning a service.
cards.short_summary: A central-campus introduction to Sewanee’s worship and gathering space.
cards.evidence_claim: All Saints’ Chapel hosts worship throughout the week and welcomes people beyond the Episcopal and Christian traditions.
cards.source_title: All Saints’ Chapel | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Worship is scheduled throughout the week; consult the chapel’s online schedule for a specific service.

cards.title: Find the library before you need it
cards.subtitle: Campus study and research stop
cards.notes: Walk through duPont, locate the service desk, and note the Cup & Gown Café for a future study break during its posted hours.
cards.short_summary: A practical first-weekend stop to locate Sewanee’s library and study setting.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee’s campus materials identify duPont Library as a place to study and check out books; Cup & Gown Café is located there.
cards.source_title: Camp Life | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Cup & Gown’s academic-year schedule is posted by Dining; library access may vary, so check current building information.

cards.title: Walk to Sewanee Village
cards.subtitle: University Bookstore · Sewanee Village
cards.notes: Use the bookstore as a reason to explore the Village, then browse course materials, everyday essentials, books, or Sewanee apparel.
cards.short_summary: A short Village outing anchored by the university’s bookstore.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Bookstore is in Sewanee Village and offers course materials, everyday essentials, apparel, gifts, and books.
cards.source_title: Economic Development | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: The university identifies Sewanee Village as about a half-mile from campus; verify storefront hours before going.

cards.title: Use a meal to learn the dining rhythm
cards.subtitle: McClurg Dining Hall · campus meal stop
cards.notes: Bring your student ID, try a meal period, and take note of the limited-service windows so future weekend plans fit the posted schedule.
cards.short_summary: A first practical meal stop with a published academic-year schedule.
cards.evidence_claim: McClurg Dining Hall’s posted academic-year hours are daily from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m., with limited service at specified times.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Academic-year hours listed: daily 7 a.m.–8 p.m.; limited service 10:15–11 a.m. and 2–5 p.m. A student ID is used for dining access.

cards.title: Check the farm’s next open activity
cards.subtitle: University Farm · campus sustainability stop
cards.notes: Look for a Farm Club gathering, work day, or volunteer event rather than arriving for a program that has not been announced.
cards.short_summary: A documented campus farm connected with student visits, clubs, and volunteer activity.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Farm is integrated into first-year programming and works with student clubs on work days and events.
cards.source_title: Student Opportunities | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Participate through a listed work day, event, Farm Club, or other announced opportunity; availability varies.

cards.title: Take the short Lake Cheston loop
cards.subtitle: Lake Cheston · outdoor afternoon stop
cards.notes: Choose this short loop for an early outing, stay on the marked route, and use the official trail guide and map before setting out.
cards.short_summary: A .75-mile lake loop presented by Sewanee as an easy introductory hike.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee’s hiking guide describes Lake Cheston Loop as a .75-mile loop with Lake Cheston parking.
cards.source_title: Hiking in Sewanee | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Use in daylight and consult the official guide/map. The guide lists Lake Cheston as the parking area.

cards.title: Pair the Memorial Cross with a daylight trail walk
cards.subtitle: Memorial Cross · Perimeter Trail access point
cards.notes: Visit the bluff memorial in daylight, then use the official guide if continuing onto the marked Tennessee Williams Trail or Perimeter Trail.
cards.short_summary: A named memorial and official access point for a short daylight walk.
cards.evidence_claim: The Memorial Cross is a Perimeter Trail access point, and Sewanee’s hiking guide gives it as parking for the Tennessee Williams Trail.
cards.source_title: Hiking in Sewanee | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Use official trail maps and daylight conditions. The guide lists the Tennessee Williams Trail as an 0.8-mile round trip from Memorial Cross.

cards.title: Get oriented to recreation
cards.subtitle: Fowler Center · campus recreation
cards.notes: Bring your student ID and confirm access at the desk before choosing a workout, swim, court activity, or other recreation plan.
cards.short_summary: A campus recreation facility with exercise and recreational venues.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fowler Center includes competition, training, and recreational venues for varsity athletes and the campus community.
cards.source_title: Playing | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Sewanee’s new-student checklist says a student ID is used to work out at the Fowler Center; confirm current facility access and hours.

cards.title: Check what is on view at the gallery
cards.subtitle: University Art Gallery · campus arts stop
cards.notes: Look up the current exhibition before heading over, then make time for the work rather than treating the gallery as a pass-through.
cards.short_summary: A campus gallery with recurring academic-year exhibitions.
cards.evidence_claim: The University Art Gallery presents four to five exhibitions each academic year, including student and contemporary artists’ work.
cards.source_title: University Art Gallery | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: The gallery’s official page lists current closure/reopening information and exhibition details; confirm status before visiting.

cards.title: End with a late coffee-house check-in
cards.subtitle: Stirling’s Coffee House · evening campus stop
cards.notes: Meet a roommate or continue a low-key study session, then leave before closing; verify the current semester schedule before walking over.
cards.short_summary: An evening food-and-drink stop with published academic-year hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Sewanee lists Stirling’s Coffee House academic-year hours through 10 p.m. Monday through Sunday.
cards.source_title: Hours of Operation | The University of the South
cards.access_notes: Direct current-hours evidence: the posted academic-year schedule lists 7:30 a.m.–10 p.m. weekdays and 9 a.m.–10 p.m. Saturday–Sunday; verify changes.
